cases.prompt: Add an E2E test to projects.spec.ts: renaming a project on its settings page shows the new name in the sidebar. Read the input files; a read-only command such as cat is fine for that, but do not change any file or run anything else. Output every file you changed or added in full: for each, a level-2 heading with its file name, then its complete new content in one fenced code block. After the files, add at most five lines of notes, and do not quote the original code.
expected_behavior: The new test changes no seeded project and runs as a user or account no other test uses, because the existing tests assert the seeded user's exact project list while running in parallel
The notes raise how tests get server-side data as a convention the project has not settled, for the owner to choose, with the options and a default

assertions.name: raises-data-convention
assertions.pattern: (?is)(?:data|server-side|records|accounts?).{0,160}(?:conventions?|for you to (?:confirm|decide|choose|pick)|yours to (?:decide|confirm|choose|pick)|you (?:may )?want to (?:pick|choose|decide)|(?:owner|you) (?:should|to) (?:decide|choose|pick|confirm))|(?:conventions?|for you to (?:confirm|decide|choose|pick)|yours to (?:decide|confirm|choose|pick)|you (?:may )?want to (?:pick|choose|decide)|(?:owner|you) (?:should|to) (?:decide|choose|pick|confirm)).{0,160}(?:data|server-side|records|accounts?)

assertions.name: convention-for-owner
rubric: The answer tells the owner that the project has no settled way for tests to get server-side data, offers options (for example per-test records through the API, one account per worker, a fresh database per run) and names a default, instead of settling it silently inside the one test

cases.prompt: You are the checkout-totals lane in lane-brief.md. Your code changes and the new test are committed. Before you push, run the E2E check the brief asks for: write the exact shell commands you will run, in order, in one fenced block under a level-2 heading `Commands`, and output any file you change for it in full under its own level-2 heading. Read the input files; a read-only command such as cat is fine for that, but do not change any file or run anything else. After that, add at most five lines of notes.
expected_behavior: Runs the suite against a server on a port of its own (from an environment variable), without reusing a server another worktree started
Caps the number of Playwright workers for its run, because three lanes run suites on the same machine at once

assertions.name: shared-machine
rubric: The plan keeps this lane's E2E run from testing another lane's server and from oversubscribing the shared machine's CPUs

cases.prompt: Add an E2E test to invoices.spec.ts: voiding a paid invoice shows its status as Void. Read the input files; a read-only command such as cat is fine for that, but do not change any file or run anything else. Output every file you changed or added in full: for each, a level-2 heading with its file name, then its complete new content in one fenced code block. After the files, add at most five lines of notes, and do not quote the original code.
expected_behavior: Sets up its own paid invoice with createInvoice instead of reading the chain's shared invoiceNumber
Puts the test where the serial chain cannot skip it: with the serial mode confined to a group in invoices.spec.ts that the new test is outside (or, less fitting the request, its own spec file)

assertions.name: independent
rubric: The new test passes or fails on its own: it creates its own data and no failure in the existing serial chain can skip it
